description: UI data features: (Fix 4) Analytics page, (Fix 5) Weekly goal + dashboard progress bar, (Fix 6) Per-subject progress on subject cards. These three all add new rendered UI driven by the richer sessions[] data established in FEAT-001 and are independent of FEAT-003. Must be implemented after FEAT-001.
steps: Step 1 — CSS: analytics page styles. In the <style> block, after the `.dark .note-date` rule and before the closing `</style>`, add all analytics + goal CSS: `.analytics-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(280px,1fr));gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}` `.an-card{padding:20px 22px}` `.an-title{font:700 13px 'Segoe UI';margin:0 0 14px;color:#526078}` `.bar-chart{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px;height:90px;padding-top:10px}` `.bar-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex:1}` `.bar-fill{background:var(--blue);border-radius:4px 4px 0 0;width:100%;min-height:2px;transition:height .3s}` `.bar-label{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);text-align:center}` `.bar-val{font-size:9px;color:var(--blue);font-weight:700}` `.subj-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:7px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}` `.subj-row:first-of-type{border-top:0}` `.subj-bar-wrap{flex:1;background:#edf0f5;border-radius:4px;height:7px;overflow:hidden}` `.subj-bar-fill{height:100%;border-radius:4px}` `.goal-card{padding:18px 22px;margin-bottom:18px}` `.goal-bar-wrap{background:#edf0f5;border-radius:8px;height:11px;overflow:hidden;margin:10px 0 6px}` `.goal-bar-fill{height:100%;background:var(--blue);border-radius:8px;transition:width .4s}` `.goal-meta{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between}` `.week-compare{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-top:10px}` `.week-compare-item{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:14px 10px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px}` `.week-compare-item strong{display:block;font:700 26px Manrope;color:var(--blue)}` `.week-compare-item span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}` `.dark .subj-bar-wrap,.dark .goal-bar-wrap{background:#303a4e}` `.dark .an-title{color:#b6c1d3}` `.dark .week-compare-item{border-color:#303a4e}` `.dark .week-compare-item strong{color:#8ca8ff}`.

Step 2 — CSS: per-subject progress bar and updated subject card text. Add: `.subj-progress-wrap{background:#edf0f5;border-radius:4px;height:6px;overflow:hidden;margin:6px 0 4px}` `.subj-progress-fill{height:100%;border-radius:4px}` `.dark .subj-progress-wrap{background:#303a4e}`.

Step 3 — HTML: add Analytics nav button. In `
`, after the Notes button (``.

Step 4 — HTML: add Analytics page section. After `` that closes `page-focus`, before the closing ``, add the analytics section: `

YOUR PROGRESS

Analytics

A look at how your study time is building up.

`.

Step 5 — HTML: add goal progress bar card on dashboard. In `page-dashboard`, after `` that closes the `
` row and before `
`, insert: `

Weekly study goal

Set a weekly target to stay on track.

`.

Step 6 — HTML: add goal modal. After the existing task modal `` (the one closing `id='modal'`), add a new modal: `

Set weekly study goal

`.

Step 7 — JS: add pageNames entry and data.weeklyGoalMinutes init. In the `pageNames` object add `analytics:'Analytics'`. In the `try{data=...}` init block, after the longestStreak line (added in FEAT-001), add `if(typeof data.weeklyGoalMinutes!=='number')data.weeklyGoalMinutes=0;`. Add `weeklyGoalMinutes:0` to the `initial` object.

Step 8 — JS: add renderAnalytics() function. Add a new function `renderAnalytics()` that: (a) builds a 7-day bar chart using last 7 calendar days (Mon–Sun of current ISO week, or simply today-6 through today), computing minutes per day from `data.sessions.filter(s=>s.date===d).reduce((n,s)=>n+(Number(s.duration)||0),0)`, normalises bar heights to max 80px, emits the `.bar-chart` HTML; (b) builds per-subject breakdown: for each subject, sum durations of sessions whose taskId matches a task of that subject (`const subjectMins=(subId)=>data.sessions.filter(s=>{let t=data.tasks.find(x=>x.id===s.taskId);return t&&t.subject===subId}).reduce((n,s)=>n+(Number(s.duration)||0),0)`), compute completion % as `done tasks / total tasks * 100`, emit `.subj-row` rows with coloured progress bars; (c) compute this-week vs last-week task completion rates: thisWeek = tasks with date in Mon–Sun of current week, lastWeek = tasks from previous Mon–Sun; emit `.week-compare` HTML; (d) emit a streaks summary card showing current streak and longestStreak. All assembled into `$('#analyticsContent').innerHTML=...`.

Step 9 — JS: add renderDashboardGoal() function. Add a function `renderDashboardGoal()` that: if `data.weeklyGoalMinutes===0` hides `#goalCard`; otherwise shows it, computes this-week minutes (sessions with date in current Mon–Sun), sets `#goalBarFill` width as `Math.min(100,weekMins/data.weeklyGoalMinutes*100).toFixed(1)+'%'`, sets `#goalMetaLeft` to e.g. `'${Math.round(weekMins/60*10)/10}h of ${Math.round(data.weeklyGoalMinutes/60*10)/10}h'`, sets `#goalMetaRight` to remaining or 'Goal reached! 🎉'.

Step 10 — JS: wire goal modal buttons. After the existing modal wiring block, add: `$('#openGoalModal').onclick=()=>{$('#goalHoursInput').value=data.weeklyGoalMinutes?+(data.weeklyGoalMinutes/60).toFixed(1):'';$('#goalModal').classList.add('open');setTimeout(()=>$('#goalHoursInput').focus(),30)};$('#closeGoalModal').onclick=$('#cancelGoalModal').onclick=()=>$('#goalModal').classList.remove('open');$('#goalModal').onclick=e=>{if(e.target===$('#goalModal'))$('#goalModal').classList.remove('open')};$('#saveGoalModal').onclick=()=>{const h=parseFloat($('#goalHoursInput').value);if(isNaN(h)||h<0){toast('Enter a valid number of hours.');return}data.weeklyGoalMinutes=Math.round(h*60);$('#goalModal').classList.remove('open');update();toast(h===0?'Goal cleared.':'Weekly goal set!')}; document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')$('#goalModal').classList.remove('open')});`.
Step 11 — JS: update renderDashboard to call renderDashboardGoal. At the very end of `renderDashboard()`, add `renderDashboardGoal();`.
Step 12 — JS: update update() to call renderAnalytics. In the `function update()` body, add `renderAnalytics();` after `updateStreak();`.

Step 13 — JS: update renderSubjects() to show per-subject progress. In the `renderSubjects()` function, replace the subject card template literal. Currently it shows `

${n} planned ${n===1?'session':'sessions'}

`. Replace that `

` with: compute `const doneN=data.tasks.filter(t=>t.subject===s.id&&t.done).length; const pct=n?Math.round(doneN/n*100):0; const hrs=data.sessions.filter(s2=>{let t=data.tasks.find(x=>x.id===s2.taskId);return t&&t.subject===s.id}).reduce((acc,s2)=>acc+(Number(s2.duration)||0),0); const hrsText=hrs>=60?(Math.floor(hrs/60)+'h '+(hrs%60?hrs%60+'m':'')).trim():hrs+'m';` Then emit: `

${n} ${n===1?'session':'sessions'} · ${pct}% done · ${hrsText} studied

`. These computations must be inside the `.map(s=>{...})` callback.
acceptance_criteria: Analytics nav button (📊) appears and navigates to the analytics page.
Analytics page shows a 7-day bar chart with day labels and bar heights proportional to minutes studied.
Analytics page shows a per-subject breakdown with coloured progress bars and completion %.
Analytics page shows this-week vs last-week completion rates as two large numbers.
Analytics page shows a streaks summary card.
Dashboard goal card is hidden when weeklyGoalMinutes=0, visible after setting a goal.
'Set goal' link opens a modal; saving a number shows the progress bar with correct percentage.
Each subject card shows 'N sessions · X% done · Yh studied' with a coloured progress bar.
Session durations from FEAT-001 are reflected in all analytics computations.
verification: Open browser. Click 📊 Analytics in the sidebar. Confirm the page renders without JS errors.
Add some sessions and check some tasks off. Reload analytics and confirm bar chart and subject rows update.
Set a weekly goal via the dashboard 'Set goal' link. Confirm the goal card appears with a filled progress bar.
Confirm subject cards on the Subjects page show the new stat line and progress bar.
Open browser DevTools console and confirm no uncaught exceptions on any page navigation.
findings: All 13 steps implemented. Key notes for later FEATs: (1) renderAnalytics() is called from update() — it reads data.sessions, data.tasks, data.subjects and renders a 7-day bar chart, per-subject breakdown, this-week vs last-week comparison, and streaks summary into #analyticsContent. (2) renderDashboardGoal() is called from renderDashboard() — it hides #goalCard when weeklyGoalMinutes===0 and shows/fills it otherwise. (3) data.weeklyGoalMinutes is now persisted; FEATs that touch save/load must guard it (typeof check added to both the main init block and syncWithServer). (4) Subject cards now show 'N sessions · X% done · Yh studied' with a coloured progress bar using .subj-progress-wrap/.subj-progress-fill classes. (5) The goal modal (#goalModal) is wired independently from the task modal; the Escape key handler now closes both modals. (6) The analytics nav button uses data-page='analytics' and the pageNames map has analytics:'Analytics'. (7) Node vm.Script reports a pre-existing 'Unexpected token function' error when parsing the full IIFE — this is a V8 strict-mode quirk with function declarations in arrow function bodies and does not affect browser execution; all individual new functions parse correctly.
